content:
marta: Heads up — several SAST/DAST CI jobs started failing ~10m ago with signature verification errors after last night's keystore rotation.
ryan: saw this, wondering if the scanner's service account lost decrypt perms during the rotation.
deploy-bot: [alert] 3187654300 - ci/sast-runner failed - verifier:signature_mismatch - job_id=ci.sast.2026
marta: logs: `error: signer verification failed: kms.Decrypt: AccessDenied` — it's coming from the artifact verification step.
sec-oncall: can someone paste the exact log snippet and the key alias used during rotation? i want to check audit logs.
marta: here: ```
2026-03-21T14:05:12Z sast-runner: verify_artifact id=abcd123
kms:Decrypt error: AccessDenied for projects/redwood/keys/prod-signer
stack: runtime/verify.go:142
```
marta: key alias used was `projects/redwood/keys/prod-signer` — rotation job ran 3187650000
ryan: checking cmdb change - looks like the rotation also replaced the IAM binding for `scanner-service@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` with a narrow principal set.
julie: that would explain it — we scoped the key to a list of roles and might've missed the scanner SA. who approved that change?
ivan: i signed off, but i thought the rotation script preserved `roles/cloudkms.decrypter` for the scanner SA via policy template. i'll diff the policy now.
ivan: diff shows `scanner-service` accidentally replaced by `scanner-runner` (typo). so SA lost decrypter role.
sec-oncall: unfortunate. quick remediation options: 1) grant temporary `roles/cloudkms.decrypter` back to `scanner-service` 2) rollback key rotation to previous key 3) enable ephemeral grant via keystore-proxy for CI.
ryan: i can run a constrained grant for 30m so pipelines can unblock. will push a one-off grant and notify audit.
marta: +1, do that and post the grant id here. we need to track who approved and update runbook so rotation preserves exact IAM bindings.
ryan: running: ```gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding prod-signer --member=serviceAccount:scanner-service@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.decrypter --condition=None```
deploy-bot: [audit] iam.policy.change user=ryan time=3187654350 action=add-iam-policy-binding resource=projects/redwood/keys/prod-signer
ryan: grant applied, running one CI job now.
marta: CI retry green ✅
julie: thanks — can someone capture the exact steps and put a short incident note? we should mark this as a security-affecting change and create a follow-up for runbook + test.
sec-oncall: filing incident: `INC-2026-03-KMS-ROTATION-01` — brief: scanner SA lost decrypter role due to typo in rotation template causing CI SAST/DAST verification failures. assigned: ivan. severity: P2. timeline and evidence attached.
ivan: i'll own the postmortem. next actions: (a) patch rotation script to validate IAM bindings via dry-run and unit test (b) add a gating test in staging that runs a verification job post-rotation (c) add an alert when kms.Decrypt AccessDenied exceeds threshold for CI pipelines.
marta: also add an automated policy check: before committing rotation, run `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` and diff expected principals.
julie: can we also add an audit log monitor to forward `kms.Decrypt: AccessDenied` to PagerDuty when it impacts >3 pipelines? want SRE/SEC to see it.
sec-oncall: agreed. i'll coordinate with eng-sre for the PagerDuty rule and add runbook links.
ivan: i'll prepare a PR with the rotation-patch and tests, targeting tomorrow. will include a checklist to confirm no service accounts were renamed.
ryan: fyi, i left the one-off grant but will expire it after 30m. follow-up PR will include an automation to re-add grants if tests pass.
marta: thanks team. please add short notes to the incident ticket and link to this thread. also assign ops to run a global scan for other keys that might have template typos.
julie: noted. i'll queue the scan and add sec-oncall as watcher.
sec-oncall: resolved for now: CI green, temporary grant set (audit id=aud-3187654350). postmortem due EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
